hotspot_events.title: Nvidia probe escalates, testimony dates set: SEC enforcement at an early stage, Huang to testify publicly before the Senate on Dec 3
hotspot_events.heat_reason: SEC enforcement at an early stage (NYT) + California probe now covering possible criminal violations + Huang to testify publicly before the Senate on Dec 3 and meet House committees behind closed doors on Dec 1 + 10-Q delayed; NVDA fell 14.01% in a day, then rebounded after hours
hotspot_events.summary: Nvidia closed Nov 20 at $125.53 (-14.01%), an intraday 52-week low of $124.50 and a seventh straight down day. The New York Times reported on Nov 21 that SEC enforcement staff are at an early stage, and California's probe has widened to conduct that may violate California criminal law. Huang has agreed to testify publicly before the Senate Banking Committee on Dec 3 and to meet three House committees behind closed doors on Dec 1. The 10-Q filing is delayed, with a statutory deadline around Dec 4. Reuters reported the Justice Department is reviewing the $12.9 billion Hugging Face acquisition. The stock rebounded after hours to $130.01 (+3.57%).
numbers: Public Senate testimony Dec 3; closed-door House meetings Dec 1

hotspot_events.title: Copper down 12.03% on the week but spot still tight: SHFE main contract closed Nov 20 at CNY 92,400/t
hotspot_events.heat_reason: SHFE copper -12.03% on the week and -8.2% over two days, yet the Yangshan premium hit a record $360/t, SHFE inventories are at a three-year low and the spot premium hit a record CNY 7,250/t — futures and physical markets sharply diverging
hotspot_events.summary: The SHFE main copper contract closed Nov 20 at CNY 92,400/t (-3.35%), down 12.03% on the week. The LME official copper settlement price was $12,230.50/t (yesterday's briefing cited Mysteel's $12,022.45 as an intraday low, not the settlement price — corrected here). The Yangshan copper premium hit a record $360/t (Reuters). SHFE copper inventories stood at 27,642 tons (lowest since December 2023). SMM's Shanghai #1 electrolytic copper spot premium hit a record CNY 7,250/t on Nov 19 and eased to CNY 5,800/t on Nov 20.

hotspot_events.title: Ga/Ge/Sb suspension expires Nov 27 — 4 days left, still no extension notice
hotspot_events.heat_reason: The suspension of the Ga/Ge/Sb export ban on the US expires Nov 27 with still no extension notice as of this morning; Announcement No. 58 of Nov 9 did not cover Announcement No. 72, so the ban is set to resume on expiry
hotspot_events.summary: The suspension under MOFCOM Announcement No. 72 runs to Nov 27, 2026, and as of the morning of Nov 23 no extension notice has appeared. Announcement No. 58 of Nov 9 only extended the October package of measures to Jan 10, 2027 and did not cover Announcement No. 72. On expiry, the export ban on the US resumes — 'in principle, no approvals will be granted.'
numbers: Announcement No. 58 extended to Jan 10, 2027; does not cover Announcement No. 72

industry_updates.title: LG unveils AI-driven Multi V 7 VRF heat pump (Spin X compressor)
industry_updates.detail: LG unveiled the Multi V 7 commercial VRF at HARFKO 2026 in South Korea on Nov 20: on-device + cloud AI optimizes operation, with a newly developed Spin X compressor (two-way oil supply, real-time oil-condition monitoring); capacity, COP and refrigerant model not disclosed.

industry_updates.title: Trane publishes warm-water data-center cooling tech note (hybrid liquid cooling cuts energy use)
industry_updates.detail: Trane published a warm-water data-center cooling tech note on Nov 20: a hybrid system (warm-water liquid cooling + mechanical cooling) can cut cooling energy for high-density compute, 800 VDC reduces distribution losses, with emphasis on integrated thermal management that responds in real time to operating conditions.

industry_updates.title: Hitachi completes Omika data-center lab (liquid-cooled GPUs validated alongside air-cooled servers)
industry_updates.detail: Hitachi completed the Omika data-center lab in Ibaraki on Nov 16: liquid-cooled GPU servers validated alongside air-cooled servers (including CDU), targeting sub-1°C error in second-level room temperature distribution prediction, with results feeding the expansion of its HMAX Data Center offering.

industry_updates.title: Lenovo Q2 revenue tops CNY 200 billion for the first time, AI server revenue up over 300%
industry_updates.detail: Lenovo's FY2026/27 Q2 revenue topped CNY 200 billion for the first time, up nearly 50% year on year, with AI server revenue up over 300% and the order backlog expanding to CNY 530 billion; its Neptune liquid cooling can cut data-center PUE to 1.04.

industry_updates.title: Tariff-policy sweep: no new finalized measures in the window; TSMC / Samsung pause some chip shipments to China to seek licences
industry_updates.detail: No new finalized or effective HVAC-related policies in the window; the Ga/Ge/Sb suspension expires Nov 27 with still no extension notice as of this morning; the Financial Times reported on Nov 19 that TSMC and Samsung have paused some chip shipments to China from Nov 19 to seek licences; China's export controls on drones, shield machines and dredgers effective Nov 18 are unrelated to the HVAC / CDU supply chain.

siphon_effects.detail: Nvidia's Q3 beat expectations but the escalating SEC probe triggered a seventh straight decline, with an after-hours rebound; Lenovo's Q2 AI server revenue rose over 300% year on year and its backlog reached CNY 530 billion — AI compute demand is not cooling; the siphon is shifting from 'one-way price hikes' to 'diverging demand with regulatory disruption.'
